fs.description: Reading, creating folders and deleting, with no path granted here: guard.rs adds the Hub's folders and its instances at startup, and the dialog plugin adds what the user picks. The page cannot write, copy or rename files: whatever it put in an instance or a build folder, the game or the compiler could run, so every file it saves goes through a command in writes.rs. Rust commands check paths against the same scope.

http.description: Requests from the page, limited to the hosts the Hub reads from. Downloads go through download.rs, which has its own list.

opener.description: Opening links in the browser. Folders are opened through the open_folder command, which accepts folders only.
